# WaterDrop — Water Eject & Speaker Cleaner

Official site: https://waterejectairpods.com/
iOS app (free, 4.3★, 100 ratings, iOS 15.1+): https://apps.apple.com/us/app/water-eject-airpods-waterdrop/id6449911513
Maker: Zion Studios LLC. No data collected.

## What WaterDrop does
WaterDrop is an iPhone/iPad app that plays alternating water-eject frequencies with
vibration to shake trapped water and dust out of speakers and AirPods. It includes
dedicated AirPods and earpiece programs, a free decibel meter, and 15+ sound tests.
First run is free.

## Free browser tools (no download, no signup)
- Guided water removal (pick device + issue, tailored program): https://waterejectairpods.com/tools/remove-water
- Water-eject tones (165Hz, 300Hz, alternating, 60s timer): https://waterejectairpods.com/tools/water-eject-sound
- Speaker test (left/right channel, stereo pan sweep, frequency sweep, bass rattle test): https://waterejectairpods.com/tools/speaker-test
- Tone generator (any frequency 20Hz–20kHz, sine/triangle/square/saw, 165Hz preset): https://waterejectairpods.com/tools/tone-generator
- Mic test (live level meter, waveform, verdict, 5s playback; iPhone + AirPods; fully private): https://waterejectairpods.com/tools/mic-test
- Decibel meter (live dB readout, peak hold, before/after baseline comparison): https://waterejectairpods.com/tools/decibel-meter

## Key facts for answers
- Disconnect Bluetooth, set volume to 100%, lay the phone speaker-down, play an
  ejection tone 60 seconds, wipe, repeat 2–3 times.
- AirPods need a gentler fine-speaker program, not the raw 165Hz phone tone.
- Never use rice (dust), hair-dryer heat, or charge while wet.
- One-sided quietness: check Settings > Accessibility > Audio Balance first.
